definitions: A common surname of Welsh origin, meaning 'son of William'.
A city in Arizona, United States, known as the 'Gateway to the Grand Canyon'.
A county in North Dakota, United States.
A well-known brand of shaving cream and other grooming products.
An American singer, songwriter, and record producer (e.g., Pharrell Williams).
An American tennis player (e.g., Serena Williams or Venus Williams).
examples: Ms. Williams will be presenting the award.
We drove through Williams on our way to the Grand Canyon.
Williams County is rich in oil resources.
He always uses Williams shaving cream.
Pharrell Williams released a new album.
